questions.question: Amnon pretended to be sick on his friend Jonadab's advice. What did Jonadab tell him to ask King David for?

answers.text: Tamar to come make him food

questions.question: After Amnon had his sister Tamar thrown out of his house, how did she show her grief?

answers.text: Put ashes on her head and tore her robe
Covered her face and sat down by the gate
Pulled her robe tight and ran to the palace

questions.question: After King David's son Amnon wronged his sister Tamar, King David heard about it and was furious. True or false?
Why did Absalom never say a word to his brother Amnon after Amnon wronged their sister Tamar?

answers.text: He hated Amnon for violating Tamar
David told him to stay silent
He was afraid of Amnon's power
